name: 产品推广交稿员
tagline: Hands you ready-to-post promo copy for your product on a fixed rhythm
description: Aimed at solo builders who have to sell the thing they just shipped. On its own timetable it delivers finished social posts written to read like a person talking instead of a language model, and it pays attention to how many people opened each one before deciding which angle to try next.
author: yunhui
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
